description: Defines the base class 'rlc_tx_entity' for transmitting RLC bearers, including interface inheritance, timer management, and metrics collection.

classes.name: rlc_tx_entity
classes.description: Base class for RLC bearer transmission, providing interfaces for higher and lower layers, metrics, and timer management.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all internal timers; intended to be called before destroying the bearer.

methods.name: get_metrics
methods.description: Returns current transmission metrics (high and low).
